sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打电话，他接了。

sentences.zh: 太空七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来一直致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 现在订阅可享受特别优惠，网址是nytimes.com/subscribe。

sentences.en: Welcome everyone to the Sunday special.
sentences.zh: 欢迎大家来到周日特刊。

sentences.en: I'm Gilbert Cruz.
sentences.zh: 我是吉尔伯特·克鲁兹（Gilbert Cruz）。

sentences.en: Thanksgiving has come.
sentences.zh: 感恩节已经来了。

sentences.en: Thanksgiving has gone.
sentences.zh: 感恩节已经走了。

sentences.en: And that can only mean one thing.
sentences.zh: 这意味着一件事。

sentences.en: The holiday season is fully upon us.
sentences.zh: 假日季已经全面开启了。

sentences.en: And it's time to start thinking about gifts for your family and friends.
sentences.zh: 是时候开始考虑为家人和朋友准备礼物了。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: I get it.
sentences.zh: 我懂的。

sentences.en: This can be a stressful activity, but do not despair.
sentences.zh: 这可能是一项令人压力的活动，但别灰心。

sentences.en: Because I am here to tell you that books are the best gifts.
sentences.zh: 因为我在这里要告诉你，书是最好的礼物。

sentences.en: You can literally find a book for every single person on your list, no matter what they're into, no matter if they even read books.
sentences.zh: 你真的可以为你名单上的每个人找到一本书，无论他们喜欢什么，也无论他们是否真的读书。

sentences.en: So that is what we're going to talk about today.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我们今天要讨论的内容。

sentences.en: With me today are two of my colleagues who I often pester for gift ideas for people in my life.
sentences.zh: 今天和我在一起的是我的两位同事，我经常缠着她们要礼物点子，送给我生活中的人。

sentences.en: Both are editors at The Book Review.
sentences.zh: 她们都是《书评》的编辑。

sentences.en: Jumana Khatib.
sentences.zh: 朱玛娜·哈提卜（Jumana Khatib）。

sentences.en: Welcome, Jumana.
sentences.zh: 欢迎你，朱玛娜。

sentences.en: Hi, Gilbert.
sentences.zh: 嗨，吉尔伯特。

sentences.en: And Sadie Stein.
sentences.zh: 还有萨迪·斯坦（Sadie Stein）。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Before we dive in, you both read books for a living.
sentences.zh: 在我们深入探讨之前，你们两位都是以读书为生。

sentences.en: Amazing job.
sentences.zh: 了不起的工作。

sentences.en: But what does reading for pleasure look like for both of you?
sentences.zh: 但对你们俩来说，为了消遣而阅读是什么样的呢？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: I know myself well enough that this is going to sound like parody.
sentences.zh: 我很了解自己，这听起来可能像是在模仿。

sentences.en: Um, but I will read any book that doesn't have a plot.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我会读任何没有情节的书。

sentences.en: I will read any book about a narrator in some kind of lowercase D distress.
sentences.zh: 我会读任何关于叙述者处于某种轻微困境中的书。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Um, I don't like true crime.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不喜欢真实犯罪类。

sentences.en: I think left to my own devices.
sentences.zh: 我想如果由我自己决定的话。

sentences.en: I tend to read mostly fiction.
sentences.zh: 我倾向于主要读小说。

sentences.en: I salivate at translated fiction.
sentences.zh: 我对翻译小说垂涎三尺。

sentences.en: I think that's very exciting.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那非常令人兴奋。

sentences.en: And I like a book that really surprises me.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢真正能给我惊喜的书。

sentences.en: Oh, and also the dialogue can't be bad.
sentences.zh: 哦，还有对话不能写得太烂。

sentences.en: Like, like that is, that is something that will make me put down a book is, um, really bad spoken conversation.
sentences.zh: 比如，那确实是会让我放下书的原因，就是非常糟糕的口语对话。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Sadie, you were on the Sunday special earlier this year when we talked about going back to school, things that we read when we were younger.
sentences.zh: 萨迪，你今年早些时候上过周日特刊，当时我们谈论了重返校园，以及我们年轻时读过的东西。

sentences.en: However, however, I sit next to you and I know that particularly when it comes to nonfiction, although you're one of the most well-read people I know,
sentences.zh: 然而，我坐在你旁边，我知道尤其是非虚构类作品，虽然你是我认识的人中阅读量最大的人之一，

sentences.en: the sort of the range that you possess is absolutely insane.
sentences.zh: 你所拥有的阅读范围简直疯狂。

sentences.en: What are the type of things that you go to, you know, when you don't have to read a ton for work?
sentences.zh: 当你不需要为了工作而大量阅读时，你会去读什么类型的书呢？

sentences.en: Yeah, my tastes are pretty Catholic.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的品味相当广泛。

sentences.en: I guess I do like eclectic books.
sentences.zh: 我想我确实喜欢折衷主义的书籍。

sentences.en: I like anything about, um, dolls and ghosts, of course.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢任何关于，嗯，玩偶和鬼魂的东西，当然。

sentences.en: And, um, but that's really the same thing.
sentences.zh: 而且，嗯，但这其实是一回事。

sentences.en: That's just about absence and humanity, right?
sentences.zh: 那只是关于缺失和人性，对吧？

sentences.en: So basically, uh, anything to do with that.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，嗯，任何与此相关的东西。

sentences.en: Uh, I like things about crafts.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我喜欢关于工艺的东西。

sentences.en: I like interiors.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢室内设计。

sentences.en: I like books with really good rooms described in them.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢书中对房间描写得很好的书。

sentences.en: I like fiction with good food.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢有美食描写的小说。

sentences.en: Um, that's very important.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那非常重要。

sentences.en: I don't love, um, apocalypses, but, you know, I'm, I'm learning to love them.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢，嗯，末日题材，但是，你知道，我正在学习去喜欢它们。

sentences.en: I don't tend to love, uh, novels about mothers and children.
sentences.zh: 我不太喜欢，嗯，关于母亲和孩子的小说。

sentences.en: Oh, do not say that to Jumana, by the way.
sentences.zh: 哦，顺便说一句，千万别对朱玛娜说这个。

sentences.en: That's all I read.
sentences.zh: 我只读那种书。

sentences.en: She loves a book about a mom.
sentences.zh: 她热爱关于妈妈的书。

sentences.en: Especially a single one.
sentences.zh: 尤其是单亲妈妈。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Um.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I don't know why.
sentences.zh: 我不知道为什么。

sentences.en: It's very fair.
sentences.zh: 这很公平。

sentences.en: And, um, but yeah, as you know, looking at my, at my desk, it's stuff I'm interested in.
sentences.zh: 而且，嗯，但是是的，正如你所知，看看我的办公桌，那都是我感兴趣的东西。

sentences.en: It's stuff I, in real life, will never do.
sentences.zh: 那都是我在现实生活中永远不会做的事情。

sentences.en: Like, like gardening.
sentences.zh: 比如，园艺。

sentences.en: It's, um, museum exhibits I won't get to.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我没机会去的博物馆展览。

sentences.en: It's things that remind me of when I was five years old.
sentences.zh: 那是让我回想起五岁时的事情。

sentences.en: It's random books my grandparents gave me.
sentences.zh: 那是祖父母给我的随机书籍。

sentences.en: There's no rhyme or reason to my reading.
sentences.zh: 我的阅读没有任何逻辑或理由。

sentences.en: It is, I think I can break an algorithm.
sentences.zh: 我想我可以打破算法。

sentences.en: All right, well, I think that is a great transition into what we're here to talk about, which is, um, some of the best books of the year.
sentences.zh: 好的，好吧，我认为这是一个很好的过渡，进入我们今天要讨论的主题，也就是，嗯，今年的一些好书。

sentences.en: We, as a group, over the course of a year, read hundreds and hundreds of hundreds of books.
sentences.zh: 我们作为一个团队，在一年中阅读了成百上千本书。

sentences.en: And at the New York Times Book Review, somehow, we distill that down to 100 books, which we call our 100 Notable Books.
sentences.zh: 而在《纽约时报书评》，我们以某种方式将其提炼为100本书，我们称之为“100本值得注意的书”。

sentences.en: Uh, the two of you, in addition to many of our other editors who are involved in this process, you are reading a lot of these books.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你们两位，除了参与此过程的其他许多编辑外，你们正在阅读其中的许多书。

sentences.en: Uh, before we get into incredibly specific category recommendations, which we're going to do in the second part of this conversation, I would love for the two of you to reflect
sentences.zh: 嗯，在我们进入极其具体的类别推荐之前，我们将在对话的第二部分进行，我很想请你们两位反思一下

sentences.en: on the things that you loved from this year most, because, um, because we read so many.
sentences.zh: 你们今年最喜欢的书，因为，嗯，因为我们读了太多。

sentences.en: Okay, so one of my best reading experiences, uh, was, no surprise, was a translated novel, translated from the Swedish.
sentences.zh: 好的，我最好的阅读体验之一，嗯，不出所料，是一部翻译小说，从瑞典语翻译过来的。

sentences.en: This is, uh, The Colony by Annika Norlin.
sentences.zh: 这是，嗯，安妮卡·诺林（Annika Norlin）的《殖民地》（The Colony）。

sentences.en: It's a debut novel.
sentences.zh: 这是一部处女作小说。

sentences.en: And the premise is actually pretty, pretty fascinating.
sentences.zh: 前提其实非常，非常迷人。

sentences.en: So, um, our sort of avatar is this journalist who's totally burnt out.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，我们的化身是一位完全精疲力竭的记者。

sentences.en: She can't pick up the phone.
sentences.zh: 她连电话都接不了。

sentences.en: She's just, like, she's beyond spent.
sentences.zh: 她只是，就像，她已经彻底耗尽了。

sentences.en: So she goes to the woods and observes this group of people living in the middle of nowhere.
sentences.zh: 所以她去了树林，观察这群住在荒郊野外的人。

sentences.en: She can't exactly figure out how they know each other.
sentences.zh: 她无法确切地弄清楚他们是如何认识彼此的。

sentences.en: She eventually becomes very entwined with them.
sentences.zh: 她最终与他们纠缠在一起。

sentences.en: And I thought, I, this book, I was talking about this with a colleague, and we both agreed this was the kind of book that was so well-drawn.
sentences.zh: 我想，我，这本书，我曾和一位同事谈论过，我们都同意这是那种刻画得非常好的书。

sentences.en: It was so unexpected.
sentences.zh: 它太出人意料了。

sentences.en: Every single turn took me by surprise.
sentences.zh: 每一个转折都让我感到惊讶。

sentences.en: This is the kind of book that reminded me of why reading is exciting.
sentences.zh: 这就是那种让我回想起为什么阅读令人兴奋的书。

sentences.en: And I'm not even, like, I felt that kind of, I made contact with that childlike sense of joy reading this book.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不是，就像，我读这本书时感受到了一种与童年时代那种纯粹快乐的联系。

sentences.en: So that's The Colony by Annika Norlin.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是安妮卡·诺林的《殖民地》。

sentences.en: And that's one of the books on our 100 Best Books of the Year liSt.
sentences.zh: 那是我们“年度100本最佳书籍”榜单上的书之一。

sentences.en: And we're going to put all of these titles in the show notes so you can take a look later.
sentences.zh: 我们会把所有这些书名放在节目说明中，这样你以后可以查看。

sentences.en: Jumana, you mentioned that you love translated literature.
sentences.zh: 朱玛娜，你提到你热爱翻译文学。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: What is that about?
sentences.zh: 那是怎么回事？

sentences.en: Oh, I mean, I love understanding, like, different ways that thoughts can be communicated.
sentences.zh: 哦，我是说，我喜欢理解，比如，思想可以被传达的不同方式。

sentences.en: Or, you know, when you have access to different reference points or idioms, then it becomes totally mind-expanding.
sentences.zh: 或者，你知道，当你能接触到不同的参考点或习语时，那就会变得完全开阔眼界。

sentences.en: And I have such an affection for translators because they toil in invisibility.
sentences.zh: 我对译者有种深厚的感情，因为他们在隐形中辛勤工作。

sentences.en: And I think it's one of the hardest things to do.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是最难做的事情之一。

sentences.en: I mean, I grew up in, like, a, you know, mixed language house.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我是在一个，你知道，混合语言的家庭中长大的。

sentences.en: And so I understand how hard and, frankly, existential it can be.
sentences.zh: 所以我明白这有多难，坦率地说，有多么存在主义。

sentences.en: And, like, I had no idea that this was a whole subset, apparently, in Swedish literature is, like, the burnout novel.
sentences.zh: 而且，就像，我完全不知道这是一个完整的子集，显然在瑞典文学中，就是“倦怠小说”。

sentences.en: This is fascinating.
sentences.zh: 这太迷人了。

sentences.en: Sadie, I think you have a book that you want to talk about that was translated as well.
sentences.zh: 萨迪，我想你有一本书想谈谈，也是翻译过来的。

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 我有。

sentences.en: Although, surprisingly, I think not a great favorite of yours.
sentences.zh: 虽然，令人惊讶的是，我认为它不是你的最爱。

sentences.en: This is Perfection by Vincenzo Letranico.
sentences.zh: 这是文森佐·莱特拉尼科（Vincenzo Latranico）的《完美》（Perfection）。

sentences.en: And this is, in fact, his reimagination of another book originally written in French, a book by
sentences.zh: 事实上，这是他对另一本最初用法语写成的书的重新构想，那是

sentences.en: Georges Parekh from the 60s called Things, which I also recommend.
sentences.zh: 乔治·佩雷克（Georges Perec）60年代写的《物》（Things），我也推荐这本书。

sentences.en: Basically, this is about an expat, youthful couple, millennial couple living in Berlin and then Lisbon.
sentences.zh: 基本上，这是关于一对年轻的旅居夫妇，千禧一代夫妇住在柏林，然后是里斯本。

sentences.en: And they are trying to sell their apartment on Airbnb, sell it as a desirable property.
sentences.zh: 他们正试图在Airbnb上出售他们的公寓，将其作为理想的房产出售。

sentences.en: And essentially, it goes through their lives object by object, signifier by signifier.
sentences.zh: 本质上，它通过物品、符号，逐一审视了他们的生活。

sentences.en: And it is a novel, which, although a rewrite of the 60s novel could only have been written this year, that's depressing for some, too close for some.
sentences.zh: 这是一部小说，虽然是对60年代小说的重写，但只能写于今年，这对某些人来说令人沮丧，对某些人来说太真实了。

sentences.en: For others, I think it's incredibly well observed and interesting.
sentences.zh: 对其他人来说，我认为它观察得非常入微且有趣。

sentences.en: Um, and it's short, too.
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且它很短。

sentences.en: Have I seen this book on my...
sentences.zh: 我在我的……上见过这本书吗？

sentences.en: You've seen it everywhere.
sentences.zh: 你到处都见过它。

sentences.en: On my Instagram.
sentences.zh: 在我的Instagram上。

sentences.en: You have seen it everywhere.
sentences.zh: 你到处都见过它。

sentences.en: Reels or wherever.
sentences.zh: Reels或者其他什么地方。

sentences.en: With a pink lily on the cover.
sentences.zh: 封面上有一朵粉红色的百合花。

sentences.en: Or just like people, a lot of people out there of a certain age sort of toting this book around.
sentences.zh: 或者只是像人们，很多特定年龄的人随身带着这本书。

sentences.en: Every commuter on the F train.
sentences.zh: F线地铁上的每个通勤者。

sentences.en: It's an easy read, and it's very much about appearances, ironically, and signaling and what things mean to young people today, what materialism means.
sentences.zh: 这是一本容易读的书，讽刺的是，它非常关于外表、信号，以及事物对当今年轻人意味着什么，物质主义意味着什么。

sentences.en: Do performative men read this book?
sentences.zh: 表演型人格的男人会读这本书吗？

sentences.en: I should think so, but the joke would be on them.
sentences.zh: 我想会，但笑话会出在他们身上。

sentences.en: It would be.
sentences.zh: 确实会。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Jumana, so many of us at the book review read a lot of big books this year.
sentences.zh: 朱玛娜，我们书评组的许多人在今年读了很多大部头。

sentences.en: The one Sadie just talked about, pretty small, but the one you're going to talk about, quite large.
sentences.zh: 萨迪刚才谈到的那本很小，但你要谈的那本，相当大。

sentences.en: Quite large.
sentences.zh: 相当大。

sentences.en: I forgot to mention that another one of my sort of tentpole qualities as a reader is like, the longer it is, the more interested I am.
sentences.zh: 我忘了提，作为读者，我的另一个支柱特质是，书越长，我就越感兴趣。

sentences.en: This has become my legacy.
sentences.zh: 这已经成了我的某种标志性推荐。

sentences.en: Very annoying for your colleagues, who you recommend books to all the time.
sentences.zh: 这对你的同事来说很烦人，你总是向他们推荐书。

sentences.en: I know, but I'm usually right.
sentences.zh: 我知道，但我通常都是对的。

sentences.en: You know, the bee sting.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，《蜂蜇》。

sentences.en: The bee sting.
sentences.zh: 《蜂蜇》。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: Okay, the bee sting was so good.
sentences.zh: 好吧，《蜂蜇》真的很棒。

sentences.en: I know, I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道，我知道。

sentences.en: Paul Murray's the bee sting, listeners, if you haven't read it from a couple years ago.
sentences.zh: 听众朋友们，如果你们还没读过保罗·默里的《蜂蜇》，那可是几年前的作品了。

sentences.en: So good.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: It's fantastic.
sentences.zh: 非常精彩。

sentences.en: Tell us about this next one.
sentences.zh: 给我们介绍一下下一本吧。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So this is The Loneliness of Sonia and Sunny.
sentences.zh: 这本是《索尼娅与桑尼的孤独》。

sentences.en: This has been a long cooking book.
sentences.zh: 这本书酝酿了很久。

sentences.en: This has been like 20 years in the making.

sentences.en: Welcome back.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回来。

sentences.en: I'm here with Jumanica Thieve and Sadie Stein, editors at The Book Review.
sentences.zh: 我和《书评》的编辑朱曼尼卡·蒂夫和萨迪·斯坦在一起。

sentences.en: And we are about to do you all a solid.
sentences.zh: 我们要帮你们一个大忙。

sentences.en: We are going to help you find the perfect gift for very, very specific people in your life.
sentences.zh: 我们要帮你们为生活中那些非常、非常特别的人找到完美的礼物。

sentences.en: All of them are books.
sentences.zh: 这些礼物全都是书。

sentences.en: If these people in your life do not like books, they will after you give them one of these.
sentences.zh: 如果你们生活中这些人不喜欢书，在收到这些书之后，他们一定会喜欢的。

sentences.en: Okay, let's start with the obvious, the type of person that is possibly most difficult to shop for, the, quote, person who has everything.
sentences.zh: 好吧，先从显而易见的开始，也就是那种可能最难送礼的人——所谓的“什么都不缺的人”。

sentences.en: I don't know these people, but supposedly they're out there.
sentences.zh: 我不认识这些人，但据说他们确实存在。

sentences.en: The person who has everything.
sentences.zh: 那个什么都不缺的人。

sentences.en: Sadie, what book would you buy this person?
sentences.zh: 萨迪，你会给这种人买什么书？

sentences.en: Nothing more fun than shopping for the person who has everything.
sentences.zh: 给什么都不缺的人买礼物，再有趣不过了。

sentences.en: Now, first of all, this is going to be controversial, but I think very good gift giving and especially book gift giving depends on being always alert.
sentences.zh: 首先，这可能会引起争议，但我认为好的送礼，尤其是送书，关键在于时刻保持警觉。

sentences.en: You have to have a shelf going of books for these situations.
sentences.zh: 你得为这些情况准备一个书架。

sentences.en: Whenever you're in a thrift store, at a tag sale, a book barn, a library sale, you have to be ever ready to snatch up something odd,
sentences.zh: 无论你是在旧货店、庭院甩卖、书仓还是图书馆义卖，都要随时准备抢购一些奇特的书，

sentences.en: which appeals to a niche interest or a specific geographical area.
sentences.zh: 那些能吸引小众兴趣或特定地理区域的书。

sentences.en: So, always be shopping.
sentences.zh: 所以，要时刻购物。

sentences.en: Always be shopping.
sentences.zh: 时刻购物。

sentences.en: Abs.
sentences.zh: A.B.S.

sentences.en: Yeah, A-B-S.
sentences.zh: 没错，A-B-S。

sentences.en: Have your gift.
sentences.zh: 准备好你的礼物。

sentences.en: A- always be shopping.
sentences.zh: A——时刻购物（Always Be Shopping）。

sentences.en: Have your gift shelf going at all times.
sentences.zh: 随时都要有一个礼物储备架。

sentences.en: So, ideally, according to this premise, you already have a bunch of interesting and eccentric and highly specific books from which, but let's say you're starting from scratch.
sentences.zh: 理想情况下，按照这个前提，你已经有一堆有趣、古怪且高度具体的书了，但假设你是从零开始呢？

sentences.en: Yes, let's say everyone is not you.
sentences.zh: 没错，假设每个人都不是你。

sentences.en: Okay, okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧，好吧。

sentences.en: So, let's say it's someone from Sacramento.
sentences.zh: 那么，假设对方来自萨克拉门托。

sentences.en: You look up antique guidebooks to Sacramento with beautiful art, maps and guidebooks.
sentences.zh: 你可以去查查萨克拉门托的古董指南，里面有精美的插图、地图和导览。

sentences.en: That would be a good thing, I think.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那会是个不错的选择。

sentences.en: Also, art books and garden books are basically picture books for adults.
sentences.zh: 此外，艺术类书籍和园艺类书籍基本上就是成年人的绘本。

sentences.en: And for the person that has everything, you think an art book, a gardening book, a coffee table book, you can never go wrong.
sentences.zh: 对于什么都不缺的人，送一本艺术书、园艺书或咖啡桌读物，永远不会出错。

sentences.en: Here's the other thing.
sentences.zh: 还有一点。

sentences.en: The person who has everything does not yet have a window into how you look at them.
sentences.zh: 什么都不缺的人，还没拥有一个能洞察你如何看待他们的窗口。

sentences.en: So, when you hand them a book and you say, I thought of you because of X, they're never going to read it, but they're going to think like, oh, that person pays attention to me.
sentences.zh: 所以，当你递给他们一本书并说“因为X，我想到你了”，他们可能永远不会读，但他们会想：“哦，那个人很关注我。”

sentences.en: I'm seen by the person giving me a gift.
sentences.zh: 送我礼物的人看到了我。

sentences.en: I saw you.
sentences.zh: 我看到了你。

sentences.en: I'm thinking of you.
sentences.zh: 我在想你。

sentences.en: I perceive you.
sentences.zh: 我感知到了你。

sentences.en: You're perceived, but in only the most flattering terMs.
sentences.zh: 你被感知到了，而且是以最令人受宠若惊的方式。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You know, a good one, if you're building up a shelf like this, Entertaining is Fun by Dorothy Draper.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你正在建立这样一个书架，多萝西·德雷珀的《娱乐很有趣》就是一本好书。

sentences.en: Oh, that's so good.
sentences.zh: 哦，那太棒了。

sentences.en: What is that?
sentences.zh: 那是什么书？

sentences.en: Well, she was a decorator.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她是一位室内设计师。

sentences.en: She was this kind of grand dame decorator who wrote outrageous prose.
sentences.zh: 她是一位那种写出惊人文字的大家级设计师。

sentences.en: And she also wrote this book, Entertaining is Fun, about how to entertain, how to have people over.
sentences.zh: 她还写了这本《娱乐很有趣》，讲的是如何招待客人，如何邀请朋友来家里。

sentences.en: It was written in the late 40s.
sentences.zh: 它写于40年代末。

sentences.en: It's just really fun.
sentences.zh: 真的非常有趣。

sentences.en: And the book itself looks great.
sentences.zh: 而且书本身看起来就很棒。

sentences.en: It's been reissued by Rizzoli, I think.
sentences.zh: 我想它已经被里佐利出版社再版了。

sentences.en: Polka dot cover, good on a shelf.
sentences.zh: 波点封面，放在书架上很好看。

sentences.en: I think it's a cheery and eccentric and fun, but not weird gift.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是一份欢快、古怪且有趣，但并不奇怪的礼物。

sentences.en: Do you expect that when you give someone a book that they are ever going to read it?
sentences.zh: 你送人书的时候，指望他们会读吗？
五五开吧。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。
五五开。

sentences.en: Sadie?
sentences.zh: 萨迪？

sentences.en: It depends on the book.
sentences.zh: 这取决于书的内容。

sentences.en: Because I feel like this is a thing where you are, as you say, mirroring back to them what you think of them.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得这就像你说的，是在向他们映射你对他们的看法。

sentences.en: And you maybe understand that they will put it on a shelf, they'll put it on their coffee table, and they may never read it.
sentences.zh: 你可能明白他们会把它放在书架上，放在咖啡桌上，但可能永远不会读。

sentences.en: Weren't these your wedding favors?
sentences.zh: 这不就是你的婚礼伴手礼吗？

sentences.en: Didn't you give books to every single person that came to your wedding?
sentences.zh: 你没给参加婚礼的每个人都送了书吗？

sentences.en: We did.
sentences.zh: 我们送了。

sentences.en: We had every play setting had a different book with an inscription from my wife-to-be and I.
sentences.zh: 我们每个座位上都放了一本不同的书，上面有我和我未婚妻的题词。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, actually, you can carry the rest of this section.
sentences.zh: 所以，实际上，你可以继续讲这一部分了。

sentences.en: I do not expect that most of my wedding guests read any of those books, but it's a thing to have.
sentences.zh: 我不指望大多数婚礼宾客会读那些书，但它是个纪念品。

sentences.en: It is a souvenir.
sentences.zh: 它是一个纪念品。

sentences.en: It is a thing to put on a shelf.
sentences.zh: 它是放在书架上的一个物件。

sentences.en: Maybe it spurs a memory.
sentences.zh: 也许它能勾起一段回忆。

sentences.en: As with these books, when they look at that book, they think of you, and that's hopefully a nice association.
sentences.zh: 就像这些书一样，当他们看到那本书时，他们会想到你，希望这是一种美好的联想。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Let's go to another category.
sentences.zh: 让我们进入下一个类别。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Help my mom find a new cozy crime slash mystery series.
sentences.zh: 帮我妈妈找一套新的温馨犯罪/悬疑系列小说。

sentences.en: Okay, well, if she hasn't read any Richard Osmond, she should read Richard Osmond, The Thursday Murder Club.
sentences.zh: 好吧，如果她还没读过理查德·奥斯曼的书，她应该读读理查德·奥斯曼的《周四谋杀俱乐部》。

sentences.en: It's so funny.
sentences.zh: 非常有趣。

sentences.en: And what are those books about?
sentences.zh: 那些书讲的是什么？

sentences.en: These are about octogenarians solving and sometimes perpetuating crimes, but mostly solving.
sentences.zh: 讲的是一群八十多岁的老人解决犯罪，有时也会引发犯罪，但主要是解决犯罪。

sentences.en: And these are cozy and funny.
sentences.zh: 这些书很温馨，也很有趣。

sentences.en: Cozy, funny.
sentences.zh: 温馨，有趣。

sentences.zh: 理查德·奥斯曼。

sentences.zh: 以前是英国游戏节目的主持人。

sentences.en: Yes, yes, yes.
sentences.zh: 没错，没错，没错。

sentences.en: And there's nothing unsettling.
sentences.zh: 而且里面没有任何令人不安的内容。

sentences.en: There's nothing gory.
sentences.zh: 没有任何血腥场面。

sentences.en: It's just a good old fashioned, you know, mystery.
sentences.zh: 这只是一部老派的、你知道的，悬疑小说。

sentences.en: Sadie, do you have a recommendation for a cozy mystery from my mom?
sentences.zh: 萨迪，你有什么适合我妈妈的温馨悬疑小说推荐吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 有的。

sentences.en: Well, you know, I love Janice Hallett's kind of twisty, kind of puzzle boxy mysteries, especially the mysterious case of the Albert and Angels.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，我喜欢珍妮丝·哈雷特那种曲折的、像拼图盒一样的悬疑小说，尤其是《阿尔伯特与天使的神秘案件》。

sentences.en: She does these kind of modern epistolary books.
sentences.zh: 她写的是那种现代书信体小说。

sentences.en: And I really think you have to read them as books.
sentences.zh: 我真的认为你必须把它们当作书来读。

sentences.en: They require your full attention and your full concentration and they reward it.
sentences.zh: 它们需要你全神贯注，集中精力，而且它们会给你回报。

sentences.en: And she does different things in each one, but it could be everything from a phone transcript to a bunch of text messages to, in short, it's ingenious.
sentences.zh: 她在每一本书里都玩不同的花样，内容涵盖电话记录、短信等等，总之，非常巧妙。

sentences.en: She's a brilliant plotter.
sentences.zh: 她是一位天才的布局者。

sentences.en: Check it out for sure.
sentences.zh: 一定要去看看。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Non-cookbook.
sentences.zh: 非食谱。

sentences.zh: 我会从奈杰尔·斯莱特的《吐司》开始推荐。

sentences.en: Odds are that Nigel might be new to this foodie.
sentences.zh: 这位吃货可能还没读过奈杰尔的书。

sentences.en: He's a British food writer and cook, vegetable savant.
sentences.zh: 他是一位英国美食作家和厨师，蔬菜方面的天才。

sentences.en: Toast is really about his childhood and his development of his taste and palate and sort of like coming alive.
sentences.zh: 《吐司》讲的是他的童年，以及他口味和味蕾的发展，还有那种生命力觉醒的过程。

sentences.en: Like that scene in Ratatouille when you have berries and then you have cheese and then you put them together in your mouth at the same time and it's like fireworks.
sentences.zh: 就像《料理鼠王》里那个场景，你先吃浆果，再吃奶酪，然后把它们同时放进嘴里，就像烟花绽放一样。

sentences.en: Like that's kind of what it's like, but more British and less ratty.

sentences.zh: 没那么以老鼠为中心。

sentences.zh: 没那么关注老鼠。

sentences.zh: 虽然书中有一段关于他小时候住在裸体主义者隔壁的回忆，这很有趣。

sentences.en: And I trust the Brits to render that in appropriate and slightly inappropriate color.
sentences.zh: 我相信英国人能用恰当且略带不恰当的色彩来描绘这一点。

sentences.zh: 我想说的是，对于那些对烹饪和/或书籍感兴趣的人，有一个小窍门：有很多作家都写过食谱。

sentences.zh: 这是我过去多年来逐渐爱上的两本书。

sentences.zh: 这是一套两册的书，虽然你也可以分开买。
